hashRecipe: sha256(compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of vectors)

vectors.name: canonical-ulid
vectors.note: A canonical 26-character upper-case Crockford ULID is accepted byte-exact.

vectors.name: lowest-syntactic-value
vectors.note: The lower syntactic boundary is valid; producer uniqueness is a separate obligation.

vectors.name: highest-syntactic-value
vectors.note: The first-character 0-7 bound admits the largest 128-bit ULID encoding.

vectors.name: lowercase-is-not-canonical
vectors.note: Case-insensitive ULID decoding cannot authorize case-folding before lookup.

vectors.name: mixed-case-is-not-canonical
vectors.note: A mixed-case spelling is malformed even when a lenient decoder accepts it.

vectors.name: crockford-i-alias-rejected
vectors.note: The Crockford I-to-1 decode alias is forbidden on the wire.

vectors.name: crockford-l-alias-rejected
vectors.note: The Crockford L-to-1 decode alias is forbidden on the wire.

vectors.name: crockford-o-alias-rejected
vectors.note: The Crockford O-to-0 decode alias is forbidden on the wire.

vectors.name: crockford-u-character-rejected
vectors.note: U is excluded from the canonical Crockford alphabet.

vectors.name: overflow-first-character-eight
vectors.note: A first character above 7 would encode more than 128 bits.

vectors.name: overflow-first-character-nine
vectors.note: The upper first-character overflow spelling is also rejected.

vectors.name: short-job-id
vectors.note: A jobId must contain exactly 26 ASCII characters.

vectors.name: long-job-id
vectors.note: A 27-character value is not a canonical ULID.

vectors.name: hyphenated-job-id
vectors.note: Separators are not members of the canonical jobId grammar.

vectors.name: leading-whitespace
vectors.note: Consumers do not trim a jobId before validation or derivation.

vectors.name: trailing-newline
vectors.note: Trailing whitespace is data, not a permitted transport variation.

vectors.name: precomposed-unicode-rejected
vectors.note: NFC does not make a non-ASCII jobId conformant.

vectors.name: decomposed-unicode-rejected
vectors.note: A canonically equivalent Unicode spelling is likewise rejected, not normalized.

vectors.name: percent-encoding-rejected
vectors.note: CF-4 percent decoding is never applied to a jobId segment.

vectors.name: null-is-not-a-job-id
vectors.note: A missing/null value fails before address work.

vectors.name: integer-is-not-a-job-id
vectors.note: Numeric coercion is forbidden.

vectors.name: boolean-is-not-a-job-id
vectors.note: Boolean-to-integer or Boolean-to-string coercion is forbidden.

vectors.name: buyer-bundle-known-answer
vectors.note: Bundle addressing hashes the exact validated ASCII jobId and buyer role.

vectors.name: seller-bundle-known-answer
vectors.note: The seller role has a distinct deterministic logical address.

vectors.name: orchestrator-bundle-known-answer
vectors.note: The orchestrator role uses the same byte-exact derivation.

vectors.name: lookup-after-validation
vectors.note: A resolver may run only after canonical grammar validation and derivation.

vectors.name: commit-address-preserves-job-id-bytes
vectors.note: Every non-hash logical-address template inserts the same validated bytes.

vectors.name: payment-address-preserves-job-id-bytes
vectors.note: CF-4 encodes railId, not the canonical ASCII jobId segment.

vectors.name: exact-job-id-comparison
vectors.note: Two independently parsed canonical copies compare byte-exact.

vectors.name: different-canonical-job-ids
vectors.note: Two different valid ULIDs are a well-formed identity mismatch.

vectors.name: comparison-does-not-case-fold
vectors.note: A malformed comparison operand errors instead of being uppercased into equality.
